notes.title: Let's do it!
notes.content:
[h1]Who we are[/h1]
Hi there!
We are the team behind sexandglory.com game portal and we produce adult games in a collaboration with [url=https://lessonofpassion.com]Lesson Of Passion[/url].

Some of you may know our games :)

[h1]Why Steam[/h1]
We had the idea for this game for a very long time, but despite our love for experiments we aren’t sure if our audience will be happy with Visual Novel (Kinetic Novel to be more precise) type of the game.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35099680/e960e7e60fd4f7121ccfdbfe478db886f8505da5.png[/img]

So let’s release this on Steam - as Valve is more indulgent to erotic games now - with hand-drawn art to make it even more different  from our other works :)

The game will also be available on SAG in different forms (maybe html or android version ?) for free.

And we want to support  our friends from [b]ktulhusolutions[/b] with release of [b]Perky Little Things[/b] and make [b]Yes, Master![/b] the part of promo campaign.

[h1]Why follow us[/h1]
It’s a mind control game, right?
So when the count will stop you will execute any command you get…

3...
2...
1...
